description: 163 additional distinct scenario drafts to extend 337 source-derived Click2Cloud V3+1 behavioral cases to 500
notes: Each case has initial state, steps, expected outcome, prohibited effects. Scenarios with product policy ambiguity require explicit owner review, not implementation guesses.

cases.title: no account ready: Provider root readiness snapshot
cases.initialState: Connected and authorized: none; other providers disconnected; Cloudflare-ready only when in connected set; fixture policy for disconnected menu rows requires explicit owner confirmation.
cases.steps: right-click eligible image > open REDOWN
cases.expectedOutcome: Every connected, authorized provider in this fixture has its own eligible native route; disconnected providers have no saveable route. Connected non-Cloudflare providers remain flat.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No fake success, cross-provider target, duplicate REDOWN root or invented authorization.
openProductDecisions: DISCONNECTED_PROVIDER_NATIVE_PRESENTATION: whether absent provider rows are hidden or explicit Connect actions; never enabled as save.

cases.title: no account ready: Target-specific action resolution
cases.initialState: Connected and authorized: none; other providers disconnected; Cloudflare-ready only when in connected set; fixture policy for disconnected menu rows requires explicit owner confirmation.
cases.steps: select the first ready provider, or if none, attempt an old stale saved item
cases.expectedOutcome: If ready, resolve canonical provider/account/destination and require verification before success; if none, reject stale action without capture/upload.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No fallback to a different provider or implicit first-account selection.

cases.title: no account ready: Revoked-provider stale row
cases.initialState: Connected and authorized: none; other providers disconnected; Cloudflare-ready only when in connected set; fixture policy for disconnected menu rows requires explicit owner confirmation.
cases.steps: open menu > revoke one ready provider (or use disconnected Cloudflare if none) > attempt now-stale route
cases.expectedOutcome: The selected route fails closed with a typed auth/stale reason; unaffected provider routes remain valid.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No stale-token upload or reinterpretation of a menu ID as another provider.

cases.title: no account ready: Connection change and native reconciliation
cases.initialState: Connected and authorized: none; other providers disconnected; Cloudflare-ready only when in connected set; fixture policy for disconnected menu rows requires explicit owner confirmation.
cases.steps: perform fixture-specific connection/activation change > recompile > apply newest generation > open REDOWN > authorize Google Drive
cases.expectedOutcome: The exact authorized readiness change is reflected by a new ACKed generation, without mutating other providers or creating unexpected menu participation. Additional fixture effect: only Drive becomes eligible after explicit OAuth.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No duplicate root, ghost row, silent Cloudflare mode change or assumption that a callback is proof of native pixels.

cases.title: no account ready: Mode switching with independent flat peers
cases.initialState: Connected and authorized: none; other providers disconnected; Cloudflare-ready only when in connected set; fixture policy for disconnected menu rows requires explicit owner confirmation.
cases.steps: snapshot ready provider rows > Simple → Nested → Depth → Simple > compare snapshots
cases.expectedOutcome: Only Cloudflare's mode-owned projection may change; ready Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive native action identities remain stable, and all inactive mode configs remain unchanged.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No provider nesting under Cloudflare and no mutation of connection authorization or inventory.

cases.title: All providers disconnected at launch

cases.prohibitedEffects: No silent cloud writes or invented credentials

cases.title: Cloudflare OAuth expires without refresh
cases.initialState: Cloudflare was ready; token expired; no refresh grant
cases.steps: right-click > choose old Cloudflare route > reconnect
cases.expectedOutcome: Old route blocks; after new authorization and Worker check the same destination can return
cases.prohibitedEffects: No upload before renewed authorization

cases.title: Previously selected custom default survives redown onboarding
cases.initialState: Cloudflare authorized; redown exists with user objects; previous Simple default is redown/Personal/Images

cases.expectedOutcome: Reuse existing bucket and files, preserve the previous exact custom default prefix Personal/Images, and bind Home to that prefix after current authority checks
cases.prohibitedEffects: No reset to root, object rewrite, extra bucket or public access change

cases.expectedOutcome: Default target binds B by connection ID, not by display name
cases.prohibitedEffects: No Worker call or upload on A

cases.title: Ambiguous R2 403 status

cases.title: Confirmed R2 not entitled

cases.title: Bucket creation uncertain after timeout
